decisions.decision: Roll is a spin wheel, once per day at each user's local 8:00 PM, plus one optional weekly streak reroll token. Photos may come from camera or library
decisions.rationale: Resolved during doc ingest with user approval over docs/original-concept-notes.md (STATE.md, PROJECT.md)

decisions.decision: One consolidated create-profile screen and four pre-signup marketing screens, with a numeric step indicator and no dot component
Load the Google Sign-In module lazily via dynamic import inside signInWithGoogle
decisions.rationale: A top-level import threw at module load wherever the native module is absent and took down the whole (auth) Stack (255ca31)

decisions.decision: app/index.tsx is an always-present index route, the root Stack stays mounted, and redirects target explicit group screens (/(auth)/welcome, /(app)/profile) rather than bare group paths
decisions.rationale: Bare group redirects raced the Stack.Protected guard and left a permanent Unmatched Route on cold launch. Only a real launch caught it (61855e2, a4fffa5)

decisions.decision: ios and android package.json scripts use expo run:*
decisions.rationale: Native Apple and Google sign-in modules cannot load in Expo Go (61855e2)

decisions.decision: The full DB-backed Go suite runs serialized via make test-all-integration (go test ./... -p 1)
decisions.rationale: internal/httpapi and internal/store/postgres truncate the same users table and can race under default package parallelism (01-13)

decisions.decision: Forgot-password flow and link are deliberately omitted from Phase 1
decisions.rationale: Neither ACCT-01 nor ACCT-03 requires it and a dead link is worse than none. The developer must confirm in 01-15 section F

decisions.decision: Motion follows docs/motion-interaction-direction.md through lib/motion/primitives.tsx and the onboarding choreography
decisions.rationale: Implemented 2026-09-29 (8fd36d3, 0b93368). It changed the marketing screens and PrimaryButton after the last sweep
